title: The Hanging Wood
text: Every branch for a mile holds a little bundle of cloth and string, swaying, turning, hundreds and hundreds of them. Some are knotted round small bones. Some round teeth. Some of them are still damp, and some of them twitch.

options.label: The leader cuts one down and opens it.

outcomes.text: Inside is a charm, old but strong, wrapped around a tooth.
Inside is a name, and it is the leader's, and it is fresh.

options.label: Tie up a bundle of your own, for luck.

outcomes.text: The wood seems to settle around you, as if you had answered a question correctly.

options.label: Burn a path through the bundles.

outcomes.text: The wood burns screaming, and what comes out of the smoke is not happy.
